callouts.label: Outer chord depth 0.33 to 0.93 m by a sine along the outline, phase per truss
callouts.quote: only the depth varies, d = 0.63 + 0.30 sin(2 pi s / 8.0 + 2 pi i / 11) along the arc length s of the inner outline

callouts.label: Paired 30 x 120 chords sandwich single webs in two separate planes
callouts.quote: A 60 mm gap between the chord slats gives the rising webs and the falling webs their own 30 mm plane

callouts.label: Mitred outer vertex at every corner (v02): the chamfer cut the inner chord
callouts.quote: v02 added an outer vertex on each corner's bisector at the offset-polygon position, a mitred kink with no web to it

callouts.label: Apex webs were 0.27 m stubs through v02; v03 guards the clip by the far end
callouts.quote: v03 applies the clip only when the web's far end satisfies it and asserts the reach of every web

callouts.label: Chord spacers between rings: weak-axis restraint for 28 m compression chords
callouts.quote: F 30 x 120 spacers between the facing chord slats of adjacent rings at every third outer vertex and at every inner node of the top runs

callouts.label: Roof-plane X's under the inner top chords hold the ring tops along the row
callouts.quote: one zigzag of F diagonals per roof slope, laid flat under the inner top chords in the 0.07 m gap

callouts.label: X-bracing flat on the leg faces at 61 degrees after the 45-degree rule
callouts.quote: The Researcher's 45-degree rule forced the panels to half the row's length so the X's stand at 61 degrees

callouts.label: Horizontal ties at the X ends; the upper one 10 mm under the deck eave
Box roof on its own seven slat trusses; the rings stand 0.08 m outside
callouts.quote: So the box carries itself with its own seven shallow slat trusses, and the ring trusses stand 0.08 m outside it and brace it

callouts.label: Open light band from 9.63 m to the deck: studs continue as bare mullions
callouts.quote: Both red-building photos show an opaque deck and light only from the side

callouts.label: Vertical 24 x 120 boards, joints on alternate rails per column (photo 03)
callouts.quote: joints at 1.95 and 5.85 (B columns) or 3.25 and 7.15 (A columns)

callouts.label: 1.00 x 2.10 door: kings on the module, doubled jacks, header of four slats
callouts.quote: The module gives 1.12 clear between single jacks on the +/-0.65 kings; doubled jacks bring it to 1.00

callouts.label: Ledged-and-braced leaf, braces hinge-bottom to latch-top (external source)
callouts.quote: leaf of B boards, three F ledges, two F braces at 34 degrees

callouts.label: Two truss bays past each end wall square the outer plan and form the porch
callouts.quote: two trusses at each end stand past the end walls, which is the entrance porch
